# Acta Psychologica Sinica

> A peer-reviewed academic journal publishing psychological research with focus on cognitive diagnosis, psychometric methods, and educational assessment.

Acta Psychologica Sinica is a leading Chinese-language psychology journal featuring empirical research articles, theoretical contributions, and methodological innovations in psychological science. The journal maintains both English and Chinese language versions for international accessibility.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Diagnosis
- MSCD Method
- Psychometrics
- Educational Assessment
- Multiple-Strategies
- Acta Psychologica Sinica
- TU Dong-Bo
- CAI Yan
- DAI Hai-Qi
- DING Shu-Liang
- Research Articles
- Psychological Methods

## Featured Research Articles

- [A New Multiple-Strategies Cognitive Diagnosis Model: the MSCD Method](https://journal.psych.ac.cn/acps/EN/lexeme/showArticleByLexeme.do?articleID=3461): Research article on MSCD cognitive diagnosis model by Tu et al. in Acta Psychologica Sinica, presenting a novel methodological approach to cognitive assessment and diagnosis
